name: xsolla-shopbuilder
description: Xsolla Shop Builder toolkit — guided workflows for building a hosted, no-code game storefront on Xsolla Shop Builder (edited via the `xsolla shopbuilder` CLI): site, page, blocks, and block customization.

interface.shortDescription: Guided Xsolla workflows for building a storefront on Shop Builder
interface.longDescription: Bundles the Xsolla Shop Builder workflow skills for standing up a hosted, no-code game storefront: shopbuilder-storefront (orchestrator), shopbuilder-site, shopbuilder-page, shopbuilder-blocks, shopbuilder-customize. Storefront is edited through the `xsolla shopbuilder` CLI.
